::: {style="padding-top: 40px"}
## Instacart Dashboard
:::

```{r, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)
data("instacart")
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
day_names =
  c("Sunday",
    "Monday",
    "Tuesday",
    "Wednesday",
    "Thursday",
    "Friday",
    "Saturday")

hour_labels =
  c("12 AM",
    str_c(1:11," AM"),
    "12 PM",
    str_c(1:11, " PM"))

orders =
  instacart |> 
  distinct(order_id, order_dow, order_hour_of_day, days_since_prior_order)
```

#### Instacart Orders by Day of Week and Hour of Day

```{r, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4}
heat_counts =
  orders |> 
  count(order_dow, order_hour_of_day, name = "n_orders") |> 
  complete(
    order_dow = 0:6, order_hour_of_day = 0:23,
    fill = list(n_orders = 0)
  ) |> 
  arrange(order_dow, order_hour_of_day)

heat_matrix =
  matrix(heat_counts$n_orders, nrow = 7, byrow = TRUE)

plot_ly(
  x = 0:23, y = day_names, z = heat_matrix, type = "heatmap",
  colorscale = list(c(0, "#FFFFFF"), c(1, "#002868")),
  colorbar = list(title = "Orders")
) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Hour of day",
      tickvals = 0:23, ticktext = hour_labels, tickangle = -45
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "", autorange = "reversed")
  )
```

#### Distribution of Days Between Customers' Instacart Orders

```{r, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4}
orders |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~days_since_prior_order, type = "histogram",
    xbins = list(start = -0.5, end = 30.5, size = 1),
    marker = list(color = "#BF0A30", line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1))
  ) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Days since prior order",
      tickvals = seq(0, 30, 5),
      ticktext = c("0", "5", "10", "15", "20", "25", "30+")
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of orders"),
    bargap = 0.05
  )
```

#### Top 15 Instacart Products by Reorder Rate (Ordered at Least 1,000 Times)

```{r, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
instacart |> 
  group_by(product_name) |> 
  summarize(
    n_ordered = n(),
    prop_reordered = mean(reordered),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  filter(n_ordered >= 1000) |> 
  slice_max(order_by = prop_reordered, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(
    label = str_c(product_name, "<br>Reorder rate: ",
                  round(prop_reordered, 2),
                  "<br>Times ordered: ", n_ordered)
  ) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~prop_reordered, y = ~product_name, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
    text = ~label, hoverinfo = "text",
    marker = list(color = "#002868")
  ) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Proportion of orders that were reorders",
      range = c(0, 1)
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "total ascending"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```
